# Vendored dependencies

`push-receiver/` is a source snapshot of `MrMakaroni/push-receiver-rustiq`
commit `6765a428e5a3fa94ab7c6515ef04867766caa9e3`.

The snapshot keeps Rust+ installation reproducible without granting CI or
production cross-repository access to the private push-receiver fork. Runtime
dependencies remain declared in the root `package.json` and lockfile.
